name: music-ocr
description: Fully client-side Optical Music Recognition web app (JavaScript port of copisteria, copista ONNX models, Verovio rendering)

scripts.app:init: npm run build:app && cap add android && node scripts/app/patch-android.mjs && npm run app:icons
scripts.app:sync: npm run build:app && cap sync android && node scripts/app/patch-android.mjs
scripts.app:run: npm run app:sync && cap run android
scripts.app:bundle: npm run app:sync && cd android && ./gradlew bundleRelease
scripts.e2e: node scripts/e2e-test.mjs --score test_images/reference/manifest.json test_images/Rondo-MuzioClementi-0.png test_images/Rondo-MuzioClementi-1.png test_images/Rondo-MuzioClementi-2.png
